reviews.comment: I took this class for the business minor and it was definitely tough. You are graded on homework, 4 quizzes, participation, a midterm, and a final. You can teach yourself the material and be good for the quizzes and tests. Make sure you stay on top of the material and learn the problems way beforehand. As long as you don't slack off, you'll be ok.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I don't really know the professor since it was online but they provided reminders about deadlines and assignments. The class itself was easy. Some calculations can be tedious but doable. Quizzes and exams were also easy if you just understood the homework. There were a few challenging questions but if you understand the concepts you'll be okay.

She was a nice professor, but honestly this class should not be web based. Unfortunately, if you're in it, it's probably required for you. The material is not that difficult, but having to teach it all yourself makes the work load difficult to manage with a busy schedule. Overall I did not appreciate the stress.

overall, this is a standard online class. All the information you need for homework is in the textbook/lecture materials and the quizzes and exams are just like the homework. If you understand the homework and read the textbook you will be fine. The topics on the quizzes and exams are given. The people complaining likely didn't do the readings.

Prof. Yi is horrible at teaching this class. She would change the hw dates 7-10 times a week. Her hw mcgraw hill website doesn't do anything for you unless you have chegg to check or help you out with the hw. Only took this class for the credit and I wanted to blow my brains out every week. Dont take dont take dont take
Having an online course can be pretty challenging, but luckily Dr. Yi makes it clear on what we need to review for exams and helps with problems on homework assignments.

Professor Yi is very passive aggressive when emailing. I emailed about my final grade, and she was completely not caring and would not help. 
I had an A the whole semester until she put in her participation points, and lowered my grade. I did every assignment and the discussions were unclear, and therefore dropped my grade to a B.

Really friendly, available for office hours whenever you email her! Class material is a bit challenging, since it is a level 400 class. Entirely online, you make your own schedule. Most modules/homeworks only take 2 days. I took 15 hours and deadlines for quizzes/exams were doable. She reminds about assignments and moves deadlines back if needed.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Asynchronous summer course, but quizzes and exams were similar to homework.  If you had trouble with the homework you wouldn't do well with the quizzes or exams but they were otherwise straightforward.  Responded to emails no problem, but some of the answer keys for quizzes were difficult to understand.  Curved at the end to make up for difficulty.

This class is simple if you put in the time to read the textbook and do all the available homework and practice questions. The quizzes build off of the homework, the tests build off of the quizzes. Make sure to read the book to understand the underlying principles and know how to do the calculations and variations of them (again, practice/homework)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof simply monitors the online class. Not too bad of a workload. Sends a ton of emails. Honorlocked exams and quizzes. BUT this prof was brutal when it came to the final grade. She wouldn't round me up .19 to the next letter grade... not very cash money of her a all...

Our homework and other material provided by the Professor prepared us well enough for the quizzes and exams. The textbook was a great resource to use for studying and to master certain concepts. I really enjoyed the format of this class and would definitely recommend taking this class.

Fantastic professor. Very clear in what would be tested over. Homework helped prepare for quizzes and quizzes helped prepare for exams. The course had a really good flow in my opinion. I could not recommend this professor enough. 10/10

I have no idea what the other person is saying. The quizzes are literally carbon copies of each other. If you have done the HW and understand the basics of it, then you're guaranteed to have an A in the class. So, the last person literally a lazy butt and doesn't put in any work.

She is not a good Prof; uses videos from old profs or from years ago. You believe you'll be ok on the quiz or exam by listening to the lectures and doing the HW. WRONG! The quiz and exam are way harder than the HW. She won't even have the decency to give you more review questions for the Exam to prep. Didn't know I was paying Uni to teach myself.
